title: Refined maximum-influence bound
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ have positive variance, and put $K=I/V$, where $I$ is its total influence and $V$ its variance under the uniform sign-cube distribution. Then $\exp(-2K)\exp(2)K^{-1}{}^{2K^{1/3}}\exp(-\tfrac14K^{1/3})\le\max_i\operatorname{Inf}_i(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to $\{−1,1\}$
